Releases

What changed in each Hydra release, newest first: what is new, what was fixed, what to do when you upgrade, and how to check the files you download. Every page is built from the changelog and GitHub, so it matches what shipped. Follow along with the Atom feed.

Hydra 1.9.0 Nov 20, 2026 · minor

Hydra 1.9.0 is about checking answers. You can ask it to check almost any kind of work: a label, an extraction, a summary, a support reply, a list of links or citations. When a check fails, the request reruns once on a stronger model. Prompt caching now shows up in the cost of every call, and the terminal app starts in Ask, so a first request never writes a file.

New
  • bench FaithBench suite for claims check recall and false flags #1984 · closes #1862 · @ankit373
  • bench GSM8K as a pinned bench suite #1727 · closes #1653 · @ankit373
  • bench HumanEval+ as a pinned bench suite, graded in the sandbox #1739 · closes #1654 · @ankit373
  • bench Replay acceptance policies on cached answers, with no model calls #1716 · closes #1580 · @ankit373
  • and 96 more
Fixed
  • cli Plain root help line, shared with the Homebrew formula #1557 · closes #1487 · @ankit373
  • executor Run codex exec outside a git repo, list only checked CLI agents #1930 · closes #1842 · @ankit373
  • install Refuse to install when the checksum cannot be checked #1726 · closes #1731 · @ankit373
  • npm Extract with Windows' own tar so a zip always opens #1517 · closes #1509 · @ankit373
